breakdown.description: A 25% atomic-size mismatch violates the usual Hume–Rothery size criterion for complete substitutional solubility.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves the inconsistency by correcting the atomic radius difference to 8% (which satisfies the Hume–Rothery criterion) and confirming that complete substitutional solid solubility IS expected. The generated specification instead retains the incorrect 25% figure and flips the conclusion to say complete solubility is NOT expected. Although it correctly notes that 25% violates the size criterion, it does not align with the ground truth's correction, which requires using 8% and concluding that complete solubility is expected.
